ai.firstTurn: always INCANTATION
ai.spec:
getMove(roll):
  if lastMove == NONE: return INCANTATION
  else: return DARK_STRIKE
(roll is consumed every turn but its value is never used)
INCANTATION: gain RITUAL R, R = 3 if asc<2, 4 if 2<=asc<17, 5 if asc>=17. RITUAL grants +R STRENGTH at the end of each round, skipping the round it was applied (skipFirst).
DARK_STRIKE: attack 6 every turn thereafter.
historyRules: INCANTATION exactly once, on turn 1
DARK_STRIKE every turn after turn 1

ai.firstTurn: always CHOMP (act 1). Act 3 Jaw Worm Horde variant: moveHistory is pre-seeded non-empty, so turn 1 uses the general distribution (25% CHOMP / 30% THRASH / 45% BELLOW)
ai.spec:
getMove(roll):
  if firstTurn: return CHOMP
  if roll < 25:
    if lastMove == CHOMP: return aiRng.randomBoolean(0.5625) ? BELLOW : THRASH
    else: return CHOMP
  elif roll < 55:
    if lastTwoMoves == THRASH: return aiRng.randomBoolean(0.357) ? CHOMP : BELLOW
    else: return THRASH
  elif lastMove == BELLOW: return aiRng.randomBoolean(0.416) ? CHOMP : THRASH
  else: return BELLOW
BELLOW: +STRENGTH {asc<2: 3, 2-16: 4, >=17: 5}, +block {asc<17: 6, >=17: 9}.
Act 3 Jaw Worm Horde: each spawns with +STRENGTH {asc<2: 3, 2-16: 4, >=17: 5} and +block {asc<2: 5, 2-16: 6, >=17: 9} pre-applied (Bellow effects), and rolls its first move from the general (non-firstTurn) distribution.
historyRules: CHOMP never twice in a row
THRASH never three times in a row
BELLOW never twice in a row

      else: return CORROSIVE_SPIT

ai.firstTurn: rollMove happens once, at combat start: SLEEP if ASLEEP, else SIPHON_SOUL (Dead Adventurer event spawn)
ai.spec:
Prebattle: only when spawned ASLEEP (the standard elite encounter): METALLICIZE 8 and 8 starting block. The Dead Adventurer event spawns it awake with neither.
All moves after the initial roll are chained in takeTurn (one aiRng.random(99) still consumed per turn, unused).
SLEEP (does nothing): next = ATTACK if (bc.turn == 2 [0-based; i.e. this is game turn 3] or ASLEEP has been removed), else SLEEP. Undisturbed it executes SLEEP on turns 1-3 and first attacks on turn 4.
Wake by damage: any unblocked attack damage or HP loss while ASLEEP removes ASLEEP and reduces METALLICIZE by 8; the already-queued SLEEP move still executes that turn (the real game displays this as a 1-turn Stunned intent), then ATTACK follows.
ATTACK: 18 (asc>=3: 20); next = SIPHON_SOUL if lastTwoMoves == ATTACK else ATTACK.
SIPHON_SOUL: player DEXTERITY -1 and STRENGTH -1 (asc>=18: -2 and -2), applied immediately (not queued); next = ATTACK.
Awake cycle: ATTACK, ATTACK, SIPHON_SOUL, repeating (event variant starts at SIPHON_SOUL).
historyRules: asleep: SLEEP turns 1-3 (or until damaged), then attacks
ATTACK never 3x in a row (forced SIPHON_SOUL after two)
SIPHON_SOUL never twice in a row (always followed by ATTACK)

conflicts.lightspeed: METALLICIZE is reduced by 8 (and ASLEEP removed) only when it takes unblocked damage/HP loss while asleep; on the natural turn-3 wake the ASLEEP flag and the 8 METALLICIZE persist

conflicts.note: lightspeed simplification; also, the real game shows a separate 1-turn Stunned intent after a damage wake, which lightspeed folds into the pending SLEEP move (same net timing)

Every later move is set in takeTurn: BOLT -> BEAM -> BOLT -> ... strict alternation for the rest of combat (one aiRng.random(99) consumed per turn, unused).

Prebattle: ARTIFACT 1 each.

ai.firstTurn: always GOOP_SPRAY
ai.spec:
turn 1 rollMove: GOOP_SPRAY. Fixed 3-turn loop chained in takeTurn (no aiRng consumed after turn 1):
  GOOP_SPRAY (3, asc>=19: 5 Slimed into discard pile) -> PREPARING (does nothing) -> SLAM (35, asc>=4: 38) -> GOOP_SPRAY -> ...
onHpLost: if curHp <= floor(maxHp/2): the current intent is immediately replaced with SPLIT (interrupts whatever was queued, including SLAM).
SPLIT: removed from combat; spawns SPIKE_SLIME_L at slot 0 and ACID_SLIME_L at slot 2, each with curHp = maxHp = the boss's current HP at split; each spawned slime rolls its own move on spawn and does not act this turn; +1 STRENGTH each if the player has Philosopher's Stone. The spawned large slimes can themselves split at half of their inherited maxHp.
historyRules: fixed loop GOOP_SPRAY -> PREPARING -> SLAM
SPLIT interrupts at <= 50% HP (exactly once; boss leaves combat)

ai.firstTurn: always CHARGING_UP
ai.spec:
All moves are chained in takeTurn after the initial roll (no aiRng consumed after turn 1).
Offensive (closed) loop: CHARGING_UP (+9 block) -> FIERCE_BASH (32, asc>=4: 36) -> VENT_STEAM (VULNERABLE 2 + WEAK 2) -> WHIRLWIND (5x4) -> CHARGING_UP -> ...
MODE_SHIFT: D = 30 (asc>=9: 35; asc>=19: 40), applied prebattle and stored as the running threshold. On every HP loss while MODE_SHIFT is active: counter -= hpLost; when it reaches <= 0: MODE_SHIFT removed, gains 20 block (queued), and the current intent is immediately replaced with DEFENSIVE_MODE.
Defensive (open) loop, fixed: DEFENSIVE_MODE (+SHARP_HIDE 3, asc>=19: 4) -> ROLL_ATTACK (9, asc>=4: 10) -> TWIN_SLAM (8x2; removes SHARP_HIDE; D += 10; re-gains MODE_SHIFT with the new D) -> WHIRLWIND (re-entering the offensive loop at WHIRLWIND).
Each successive mode shift therefore requires 10 more damage than the previous (30/35/40, then +10 per shift). While in defensive mode there is no MODE_SHIFT power, so HP loss cannot re-trigger it until TWIN_SLAM restores it.
historyRules: fixed offensive loop CHARGING_UP -> FIERCE_BASH -> VENT_STEAM -> WHIRLWIND
mode shift interrupts the current intent with DEFENSIVE_MODE and grants 20 block
fixed defensive sequence DEFENSIVE_MODE -> ROLL_ATTACK -> TWIN_SLAM -> WHIRLWIND (then offensive loop resumes)

ai.firstTurn: always ACTIVATE
ai.spec:
One aiRng.random(99) is consumed per turn (unused); all moves are chained in takeTurn.
Turn 1 ACTIVATE: does nothing visible; sets dividerDamage = floor(player.curHp / 12) + 1 using the player's HP at that moment; next = DIVIDER.
Turn 2 DIVIDER: attack dividerDamage x6; seq = 0; next = SEAR.
Turns 3+ follow the fixed 7-move loop [SEAR, TACKLE, SEAR, INFLAME, TACKLE, SEAR, INFERNO], driven by counter seq:
  SEAR: attack 6; add 1 (asc>=19: 2) Burn to the discard pile -- the Burn is created upgraded when bc.turn > 8 (i.e. from game turn 10 onward, which in the fixed pattern is exactly every SEAR after the first INFERNO); next = TACKLE if seq == 0, INFLAME if seq == 2, else INFERNO; seq += 1.
  TACKLE: attack 5x2 (asc>=4: 6x2); next = SEAR; seq += 1.
  INFLAME: +12 block, +2 STRENGTH (asc>=19: +3); next = TACKLE; seq += 1.
  INFERNO: attack 2x6 (asc>=4: 3x6); seq = 0; next = SEAR.
With the fixed sequence, INFERNO always lands on game turns 9, 16, 23, ... (see conflicts for the real game's Burn upgrades on Inferno).
historyRules: turn 1 ACTIVATE, turn 2 DIVIDER, then the fixed repeating loop [SEAR, TACKLE, SEAR, INFLAME, TACKLE, SEAR, INFERNO]
no randomness in move selection at any point

conflicts.lightspeed: INFERNO only attacks (2x6 / 3x6); it adds no cards and upgrades nothing; the 'upgraded Sear Burns' rule is modeled by creating upgraded Burns whenever bc.turn > 8
conflicts.wiki: wiki:Hexaghost (Enemies.lua Inferno text): 'Adds 3 Burns+ into your discard pile. Upgrades all Burns. For the rest of combat, any Burn created by Sear will be upgraded' (real game: BurnIncreaseAction + burnUpgraded flag)
conflicts.note: lightspeed omits the 3 added Burn+ and the retroactive upgrade of existing Burns; its turn>8 condition reproduces the Sear-side timing exactly (first Inferno is always turn 9) but not the other two Inferno effects
